quarterly_data.signal: Macronix September 2026 unaudited consolidated net sales were NT$8.367 billion, up 2.7% from August (NT$8.145 billion) and up 188.2% from September 2025 (NT$2.903 billion). January-September 2026 cumulative net sales were NT$53.831 billion, up 154.5% from NT$21.151 billion a year earlier.
